top_concerns: Error bound k/e^(eps/log k) (edit distance: e^(eps/(log k log n))) with polylog factors is worse than the trivial error k unless eps is roughly log^2 k or larger, so the guarantee is vacuous at eps = O(1)
No experiments, no lower bounds, and no comparison against simple baselines such as de-biased per-bit randomized response or Laplace noise on the sketch
Privacy notion protects only a one-bit change in one string, which does not match the motivating patient-record scenario

Proof gaps in DP-LCP/edit distance: XOR of O(log n) noisy node sketches inflates flip probability but is not accounted for; expectation vs high-probability mismatch in Theorem 5.1; query-side BuildTree called with eps=0 means flip prob 1/2; Lemma 4.7 conflates |z~-z| with a sum of flip indicators
Limited novelty: Pagh-Lugosi sketch plus randomized response, plugged into the Landau-Myers-Schmidt k^2 algorithm; weak fit for ICLR with no learning component
